No new focusable element or changed DOM/handler is introduced; the CSS order change affects explanatory/error rows, not the order of actionable controls. Session-wide notices, readiness, stale/unknown state and instance errors outside this row are unchanged. Existing App tests, including logout uncertainty and stale/expiry cases, pass.
